findings.scenario: Agent Studio is added to the 1440/768/390 sweep, but axe still runs in try/catch that only logs `axe skipped` and never pushes onto `problems` or changes `process.exitCode`. If AxeBuilder throws (timeout, playwright/axe error, crashed page), workbench-agent-studio@1440/768/390 still exits 0 with no serious/critical record. That is not fail-hard a11y, so the T4 visual/axe gate can pass without running axe.
findings.remediation: Treat any axe exception as a hard failure: push `${label}: axe failed/skipped: ...` into `problems` (or rethrow). Do not log-and-continue.

findings.scenario: At 768/390 the contract comments require 44px hit areas, but canvas-contract never asserts min 44px and disables the 34px check when `w > 768` is false. preview-workbench.mjs only 44px-audits Agent Studio after clicking Site advice, so hidden Teammates roster/assignment/data-class/Create proposal controls are excluded by `:visible`. Undersized Local foundation controls at 390 can pass the T4 Agent Studio E2E roster/visual/axe path.
findings.remediation: Inside openAgentStudio (or before leaving Teammates), assert visible roster radios, Assignment, Data class, and Create proposal are >=44x44 at 768/390; fail the surface if the compact workbench did not actually reopen.

findings.scenario: Navigation and compact reopen still swallow errors. For non-Agent-Studio surfaces this remains a silent skip (proof even admits Layers tree missing does not fail). For Agent Studio, a failed goto/reopen can still reach openAgentStudio on the wrong/collapsed page; if any required string/control happens to exist elsewhere, roster/boundary asserts can run against the wrong chrome instead of failing the navigation/setup itself.
findings.remediation: Remove the goto/reopen swallows at least for `workbench-agent-studio`: failed navigation, missing Edit, or failed reopen must throw into a non-zero exit before roster/axe.

audit.proof_assessment: The T4 note matches the authorization pin (docs + three e2e exact paths, read/propose, no deps/release) and honestly says Layers still skip-logs and that security review / this audit / independent verification remain open. It is not authority: 21-surface/axe-pass claims cannot be reproduced here, unnamed `npm test` skips are unidentified, and the axe/goto swallows mean a green canvas-contract log can hide a skipped a11y run. Model review stays advisory and does not authorize merge, deploy, or release.
residual_risks: Canonical architecture/threat-model Canvas claims (locked assignment, stale-completion discard, result envelope agreement, POST-before-body, no-store) are outside this allowlist’s src, so this slice cannot prove they are shipped.

openAgentStudio forbids only the exact name `Apply proposal` and uses unscoped `getByRole('radio')`; a differently named apply control or extra radios would not prove the documented no-apply boundary.
preview-workbench 390 touch audit never samples the Teammates pane.
Unnamed 4 skipped unit tests could conceal unrelated or slice gaps; proof does not name them.
